venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 10/25 (MOD/Chef KE / JMS; entered by BT; posted 2:36am 10/26).** Net $1,380 vs $1,643 target (-16%). Food $114. Comps $26 (1.91%). 47 guests, $29.37 check avg. Mostly slow until ~7:30, then steady until midnight. Handful of return guests and many new; friends from VanLuven's ice cream upstairs stopped in after a rush. Played Beetlejuice and Poltergeist. 86: ponies, Daisy Sandía (sub Manzana); low Hazy IPA. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 10/25 (Morning MOD Maggie H; Evening MOD/Chef Carey; entered by Carey; posted 2:30am 10/26).** Net incl. events $8,728.87 vs $8,280 target (+5%). DC/AM $979.96, D&C PM $7,748.91. Food $1,646.20. Comps $537.76 (6.22%). 213 guests (Tock). Sleepy Sunday: one small pop all day; no money bag in the morning so no cash; petered out ~7pm. Biggest struggle: handhelds/POS not routed to Marquee — ensure before shift. Kitchen: milk leaking in walk-in chiller, cleaned. 86 miel, miso, mocha. No-shows charged. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 10/25 (MOD/Chef Kyler & Michael; entered by Thomas; posted 4:43am 10/26).** Net $5,470 vs $4,400 target (+24%). Food $598, beverage $4,801. Comps $99.30. 134 guests (SevenRooms), $41 check avg. Same flow as Saturday but softer finish and lower volume: slow first turn building to solid flow, chill denouement. Benefited from several monster tables (dates, wine importers, members). 4 solos, 5 large parties (all fives). Top sellers: Shinebox, Rosalie, Cloudwalk Long Time Caller (tie). Kitchen: good job on heavy tickets, Michael. Door: slow start, momentum ~7:30, tiny waitlist for 2-tops and a 5-top; some off vibes from a larger party who left happy. No-shows: 3 parties (charged: Yes). Menu count 19&18. Breakage: 1 N&N, 2 Collins. Maintenance: downstairs bathroom area smelling bad.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sunday 10/25 (MOD/Chef Julian, Josh, Angel; entered by Julian Catano; posted 3:59am 10/26).** Net $4,141 vs $5,625 target (-26%). Food $643 (all Marquee; Standing Room closed). Comps ~$140 (DNLs, discounts, gifts). 123 guests, $33.67 check avg. Decent guest flow; good training day for new server team (Chelsea shadowed Jazmin). Member drop-in, Orange County guests, a few from Galaxy vs LAFC match; busy for host. Maintenance: tile by host stand. 86 hand soap. No-shows charged. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sunday 10/25 (MOD Josh / Jesse; entered by Jesse; posted 10:54pm 10/25).** Net incl. events $1,736.93 vs $2,863 target (-39%). Marquee bar $2,272.78 (gross), Garden closed, food $274. Comps $53.42 (3%), voids $17. 41 guests (2 reservations, 39 walk-ins); GCA $44.54. Slow and steady Sunday, no real pop; used downtime for guest connection, ABK and new menu R&D. Improve: pre-bussing. No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 10/25 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Shannon; entered by Alexis; posted 1:52am 10/26).** Net $14,046 vs $8,625 target (+63%). Municipal Bar AM $4,956, PM $7,513, Sun Club $307, Hot Eye $1,133. Food $5,847. Comps $574. 338 guests (OpenTable: 155 AM + 183 PM), $41.56 check avg. Strong brunch 11–3 with food tours and walk-ins; steady evening, calmer than Saturday; Hot Eye very slow without the bar crawl until post-festival/industry crowd. Kitchen slow after Saturday. Film Festival weekend. No incidents.

venues.narrative: **SEA — Sunday 10/25 (MOD Julian Abel; posted 3:04am 10/26).** Net $9,022 vs $8,000 target (+13%). Food $1,887. Comps ~$350 (~$100 DNL/SND, ~$100 member/investor, rest manager meal/industry discounts). 203 guests, $44.45 check avg.
